title: Modernizing Property Operations
summary: Designed a maintainable property-management platform around real operational workflows rather than disconnected spreadsheets.
summaryAr: تصميم منصة قابلة للصيانة لإدارة العقارات بناءً على سير العمل الفعلي بدلاً من جداول بيانات منفصلة.
challenge: Property, unit, contract, tenant maintenance and post-dated cheque information needed a shared operational record with clear ownership and history.
solution: Built a structured application with property/unit classification, rental contracts, maintenance tracking, cheque schedules, multi-company support and audit logging.
outcome: A single operational foundation designed for long-term use, traceability and future extension.
outcomeAr: قاعدة تشغيلية موحدة للاستخدام طويل الأجل والتتبع والتوسع مستقبلاً.

title: Attendance Integration & Cost Control
summary: Connected attendance and leave workflows to reduce recurring manual handling and improve data consistency.
summaryAr: ربط إجراءات الحضور والإجازات لتقليل المعالجة اليدوية المتكررة وتحسين اتساق البيانات.
challenge: Attendance and leave discrepancies were creating recurring operational rework and an estimated cost impact of around SAR 4,000 per month.
solution: Developed API-based attendance/worked-hours exchange with Saudi HR services and automated leave-request workflow handling.
outcome: Reduced manual reconciliation and addressed a recurring issue associated with approximately SAR 4,000 per month in cost.
outcomeAr: تقليل المطابقة اليدوية ومعالجة مشكلة متكررة مرتبطة بتكلفة تقارب ٤٬٠٠٠ ريال سعودي شهرياً.

title: Consolidated Odoo Infrastructure
summary: Organized multiple Linux/Odoo application environments on a single host with consistent routing and container operations.
summaryAr: تنظيم عدة بيئات Linux وOdoo على خادم واحد مع توجيه موحد وتشغيل الحاويات.
challenge: Several application instances needed independent service configuration and reliable access without multiplying physical infrastructure.
solution: Used Docker, Linux services, reverse proxy routing, SSL configuration and Portainer to isolate and manage deployments.
outcome: Operated nine server/application instances on one machine with a repeatable, easier-to-maintain deployment approach.
outcomeAr: تشغيل تسع بيئات خوادم وتطبيقات على جهاز واحد بأسلوب نشر قابل للتكرار وأسهل في الصيانة.
